intent: Bound the autonomous local-tool filesystem surface that caused the Mac swarm daemon to synchronously enumerate a 168,881-file repository and become jetsam-eligible: cap glob consumption before sorting, reject or stream file reads, bound recursive grep candidates and file size, and limit route_next background dispatch width without claiming authority over explicit topology dispatch. Preserve the existing provider, sandbox, task, and release boundaries.

gates.name: runtime-resource-bounds-ruff
gates.command: python3 -m ruff check dharma_swarm/agent_runner.py dharma_swarm/config.py dharma_swarm/orchestrator.py tests/test_agent_runner.py tests/test_config.py tests/test_orchestrator.py

negative_controls.name: glob-limit-widening-must-fail
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib, subprocess, sys; p=pathlib.Path('dharma_swarm/agent_runner.py'); t=p.read_text(); old='_LOCAL_TOOL_GLOB_RESULT_LIMIT = 50'; old in t or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(old, '_LOCAL_TOOL_GLOB_RESULT_LIMIT = 5000', 1)); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', 'tests/test_agent_runner.py::test_local_glob_stops_after_truncation_probe']).returncode)"

commit.message: fix(runtime): bound autonomous filesystem scans and route width

interface_mismatches: The previous 50-result glob contract limited only returned output; sorted materialized the complete recursive match set first. Returned cardinality and enumerated cardinality are now separate, explicitly bounded facts.
An asyncio timeout cannot preempt synchronous pathlib traversal on the event-loop thread. The filesystem operations therefore carry their own consumption, candidate, and byte bounds.
DGC_MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS constrains the autonomous route_next lane only. Explicit topology dispatch remains caller-governed and is not represented as globally semaphore-bound.
honest_blockers: Source and focused-test evidence do not prove production safety until this change is merged, built into a dependency-clean immutable release, and observed after a bounded canary reload.
Files above 4 MiB are deliberately unavailable to read_file and grep_search; a separately governed streaming or command tool is required when a task truly needs such an artifact.
The old cc85 release remains valid rollback evidence for bridge and cron processes but is not safe to restart as the autonomous swarm because it retains the unbounded local-tool implementation.
session_entry.rollback: Stop the autonomous swarm, revert this pull request as one unit, and keep com.dharma.swarm unloaded. Do not restart the cc85 autonomous daemon as rollback; its preserved release contains the incident mechanism. Bridge and cron rollback remain separately admissible after their own exact-release checks.
